tei:div.tei:p: Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, who with wisdom formed man and created in him many openings, many cavities. It is manifest and known before the throne of Thy glory that if one of them were to remain open or one of them to remain closed, it would be impossible to exist and to appear before Thee. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who heals all flesh and works wonderfully.
